claims: Prior to their 2026 tournament run, the Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball team last made the Elite Eight in 1987.
The Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball team defeated Nebraska in the 2026 Sweet 16 to advance to the Elite Eight.
The Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball team advanced to the Elite Eight for the fifth time in school history in 2026.
The Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball team's 2026 Elite Eight appearance marks their first appearance in the regional final in 39 years.
The Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball team lost to UNLV in their 1987 Elite Eight appearance.
Iowa was a No. 9 seed in the 2026 Tournament.
Iowa defeated No. 4 Nebraska 77-71 in the 2026 Tournament to reach the Elite Eight.
1987 was the 4th time the Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball program reached the Elite Eight.
2026 marks the 5th time the Iowa Hawkeyes men’s basketball program has reached the Elite Eight
